name: @alfe.ai/microsoft-mcp

tools.name: microsoft_list_accounts
tools.description: List all connected Microsoft 365 accounts. Use this before a credential-touching tool to select the account explicitly.

tools.name: microsoft_run_command
tools.description: Call Microsoft Graph v1.0 for one explicit Microsoft 365 account. The command is an optional HTTP method, a Graph path relative to https://graph.microsoft.com/v1.0, and an optional JSON body; the method defaults to GET. Spaces in OData options are encoded automatically. Examples: 'GET /me/mailFolders/inbox/messages?$top=10&$orderby=receivedDateTime desc&$select=subject,from,receivedDateTime'; 'GET /me/messages?$filter=isRead eq false&$top=20'; 'POST /me/sendMail {"message":{"subject":"Hi","body":{"contentType":"Text","content":"Hello"},"toRecipients":[{"emailAddress":{"address":"a@b.com"}}]}}'.

tools.name: microsoft_disconnect_account
tools.description: Disconnect one explicit Microsoft 365 account from this agent.
